# Faded

Faded adds sliding and stacked-pane behavior that its recorded description says blends unstacked tabs with sliding panes. It also highlights and indents the table headers of the active note, shows header icons and linked headers, and adds multi-column layouts, custom snippets, revised popovers, file tree, outliner and callouts.

![Faded screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joshkasap/Obsidian-Faded-Theme/HEAD/Faded.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Faded"
    author: "joshkasap"
    repo:   "joshkasap/Obsidian-Faded-Theme"
    slug:   "faded"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/faded"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/joshkasap/Obsidian-Faded-Theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/joshkasap/Obsidian-Faded-Theme/HEAD/Faded.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply Faded to add advanced sliding and stacked-pane behavior that blends unstacked tabs with sliding panes. Highlight and indent active note table headers, show header icons and linked headers, add multi-column layouts, custom HTML snippets, improved popovers, file tree, outliner and callouts."
}
```
